messages:
Ellen: FYI - noticed a few tenants reporting negative billed tokens in Console today.
Marco: saw it too, looks like prefetch credits + hotpath credits applied twice when reroute happens.
Rae: are we missing idempotency in the crediting step?
Theo: probable. router emits credit events on both primary and fallback. we should dedupe by invocation_id.
Ellen: quick fix: stop emitting credits on fallback, long term: add invocation_id and credit_source to telemetry (sampled).
Marco: sampling: deterministic 1% by tenant hash would let us extrapolate without exploding cardinality.
Rae: Console UX: default to "Net (billing)" with a small "Show gross + credits" toggle. show sampled vs extrapolated label.
Theo: quotas: product teams want gross for quota checks. keep enforcement on gross, billing on net. document the difference in Console help text.
Ellen: rollout plan: 1) telemetry flag + 1% sample for 2 weeks, 2) canary 10 tenants, 3) beta Console for finance dashboards, 4) optional backfill for beta orgs.
Marco: I'll draft the RFC for dedupe + sampled telemetry. Rae you ok to mock the Console toggle?
Rae: yep will send mock by EOD.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled 2026-02-11T05:00:00Z
Ellen: thx all, will open RFC and tag reviewers.
